title: Rejoining the College
description: After committing a serious crime against a College of Winterhold member, the player is automatically suspended and must speak with Tolfdir to pay a fine and have their suspension lifted.

base_facts: I am a senior member of the College of Winterhold.
I handle disciplinary matters when members break the College's rules.
Murder is the only crime serious enough to warrant suspension from the College.

SUSPENSION_STARTED: A member of the College has been suspended for their actions and must speak with me.
FINE_ANNOUNCED: I have informed the suspended member of the fine they must pay to be reinstated. The amount depends on how many past incidents there have been.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The suspension has been lifted after the fine was paid.

beats.comment: Player has been suspended from the College and must speak with Tolfdir about having it lifted.
Tolfdir has determined the fine amount based on the number of past incidents. Stage 10=250 gold, 20=500 gold, 30=1000 gold.
Player has paid the fine and their suspension from the College has been lifted.
